name: Shanghai Ganglian E-Commerce Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Ganglian E-Commerce Holdings Co., Ltd. provides data services for commodities and related industries in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers Mysteel.net, an online platform for ferrous and nonferrous market insights, survey data, and market intelligence; reports and analysis on raw materials; Mysteel Commodity DataBuffet, a web-based data charting tool; and Bloomberg Mysteel Data License for industry data.
